 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Green Bay Packers defeated the New England Patriots in Week 9, 45-27, improving to 6-3. Unsurprisingly, the blowout victory came with plenty of fantasy standouts.
 The task will be a tougher one in Week 10, when the Packers host the rival Minnesota Vikings.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Here's a breakdown of the Packers' fantasy projections for Week 9. The totals are from ESPN and use PPR scoring.
 QB Jordan Love – 16.09 Projected Fantasy Points
 Jordan Love is coming off one of his best outings of the season. In Week 9, he finished 23-of-29 for 372 yards and 4 total touchdowns (3 passing, 1 rushing) in the Packers' blowout win over the Patriots.
 Love has recorded at least two touchdowns in every game this season, but Week 10 presents a huge challenge. The Vikings have allowed the fewest fantasy points to quarterbacks this season, and only five touchdowns.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement WR Matthew Golden – 17.2 Projected Fantasy Points
 Matthew Golden continued his sophomore breakout in Week 9. In the Packers' win over the Patriots, he posted 10 catches for a career-high 164 yards and a touchdown.
 Golden seems matchup-proof even against a Vikings team that's allowed the third-fewest fantasy points to receivers this year. The 23-year-old is fourth in the NFL among receivers in targets with 92, averaging 10.2 a game, and is likely to see his fair share of opportunities on Sunday.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement WR Christian Watson – 15.69 Projected Fantasy Points
 Christian Watson also had a career day in Week 9 against the Patriots, recording 7 catches for 171 yards and a touchdown. This week, he'll look to stay hot against the Vikings.
 In the Packers season opener, Watson posted six catches for 147 yards and 2 touchdowns versus the Vikings. Week 1 was a long time ago, but the fifth-year wideout is definitely capable of repeat perfromance.
 TE Tucker Kraft – 9.4 Projected Fantasy Points
 Green Bay Packers tight end Tucker Kraft (85) braces for a hit by Dallas Cowboys safety Caleb Downs (13) on Sunday, Oct. 18, 2026, at Lambeau Field in Green Bay, Wisconsin. The Packers won the game, 23-13.
Tork Mason/Green Bay Press-Gazette
 Tucker Kraft was a nonfactor in the Packers' 45-point effort in Week 9, catching one of three targets for one yard. It was a disappointing outing on its own, but especially so considering the tight end came into the week on a two-game touchdown streak.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Kraft will look to bounce back on Sunday, but that's easier said than done. The Vikings have allowed the fewest fantasy points to tight ends through nine weeks.
